_comment: This is NOT a complete genesis.json — it is a JSON-merge-patch overlay.
Cosmos SDK genesis files are strict proto-JSON: unknown fields inside a
module's params struct fail to unmarshal, so this file cannot itself carry
inline JSON comments (JSON has no comment syntax) or ship as the literal
genesis.json consumed by the binary. Instead it is merged (via jsonmerge,
recursive-merge-objects / replace-leaves) on top of the FULL default
genesis produced by `mantrachaind init` for every registered module.
That default is regenerated fresh from the actual compiled binary every
time — see networks/devnet/README.md for why this file only overrides the
fields Eng2 actually controls, and for the full rationale behind each
value below. This _comment key exists ONLY in this reviewable copy — it
is never valid inside an actual genesis-merge patch (unknown top-level
fields fail strict proto-JSON unmarshalling), so pystarport.json embeds
the same override values without this key. `make devnet-check-genesis-sync`
verifies the two stay identical everywhere except this comment.
Eng 1 update (ark-v0.1.0-alpha): the state-machine track strips
MANTRA-specific modules (x/tax, x/tokenfactory) but retains x/sanction,
renames the bech32 prefix to `ark`, and settles the token as `esp` base
with `espees` (10^9 esp) and `KASH` (10^18 esp) as the denom units
is `espees` per docs/decisions/module-and-config-decisions.md
#8 - the denom_units entry below must match that exactly.
extended_denom_options.extended_denom is set to `espees` below purely as
accurate documentation of intent. Verified against the real vendored
source (x/vm/keeper/coin_info.go LoadEvmCoinInfo): because our display
denom is exactly 18 decimals, the `decimals == 18` branch fires and
ExtendedDenom is hardcoded to EvmDenom - this field is NEVER READ in
this configuration, only for chains with a non-18-decimal display.
Devnet intentionally keeps unbonding_time/voting_period/gov-deposit
FAST rather than mirroring the decisions doc's locked mainnet figures
(21-day unbonding #10, 7-day voting #13) - see networks/devnet/README.md's
deviation table for the per-field rationale. The SLASH FRACTIONS below
(not just durations) match the real SDK-default values from decision
#11 on both networks: testing the wrong fraction on devnet would defeat
the purpose of testing it. timeout_commit=2s (decision #12) is set in
pystarport.json's node config and applies to both networks.
This template targets the `ark-v0.1.0-alpha` binary. Base `mantrachaind init`
still has staking/mint denom `stake` and evm denom `aatom`, so the denom and
metadata overrides below remain load-bearing.
bank.denom_metadata for esp is REQUIRED, not cosmetic: the evm module's
InitGenesis calls a coin-info lookup that panics at node startup if the
denom metadata for evm_denom (esp) cannot be found. The 18 decimals are
taken from the KASH denom_unit in the same metadata record.
feemarket.params.base_fee's raw default (10^9 atto-units, roughly a
'1 gwei' analog at 18 decimals) is a normal EVM gas price and is NOT
overridden - it only looks large as a bare integer.

denom_metadata.description: The native staking and governance token.
denom_metadata.name: KASH
